cotton_aphids.immediate_steps: Remove visible pests by hand where possible and isolate heavily affected leaves.
cotton_aphids.treatment: Use neem oil or insecticidal soap labelled for this crop/pest, following the label. Encourage natural predators.
cotton_aphids.prevention: Inspect leaves regularly, keep plants healthy, and avoid broad-spectrum sprays that kill beneficial insects.
cotton_aphids.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

cotton_bacterial_blight.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves carefully, do not compost them, and clean tools after handling the plant.
cotton_bacterial_blight.treatment: Improve drainage and avoid overhead watering. A copper-based bactericide labelled for this crop may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice.
cotton_bacterial_blight.prevention: Rotate crops, use clean seed/plants, space plants for airflow, and avoid working with wet plants.
cotton_bacterial_blight.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

cotton_powdery_mildew.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering.
cotton_powdery_mildew.treatment: A fungicide labelled for this crop and disease may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice. Organic options such as sulphur or neem-based sprays are used for some fungal diseases.
cotton_powdery_mildew.prevention: Water at the base, space plants for airflow, rotate crops, and clean up fallen leaves.
cotton_powdery_mildew.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

diseased_rice.immediate_steps: Remove affected leaves and monitor whether the problem spreads.
diseased_rice.treatment: Identify the exact cause first — treatment depends on whether it is fungal, bacterial, viral or a nutrient issue. Seek local agricultural advice if it spreads quickly.
diseased_rice.prevention: Keep plants well fed and watered, improve airflow, and check leaves regularly.
diseased_rice.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

healthy_cotton.immediate_steps: Monitor the plant regularly and keep leaves dry where possible.
healthy_cotton.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep balanced watering and feeding, and remove any dead leaves promptly.
healthy_cotton.prevention: Give good air circulation, avoid overwatering, and check leaves weekly so any new problem is caught early.
healthy_cotton.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

wheat_yellow_rust.immediate_steps: Remove severely infected plants/leaves so the virus does not spread, and control insect vectors.
wheat_yellow_rust.treatment: There is no chemical cure for most plant viruses. Focus on vector control (aphids/whiteflies) and removing infected material.
wheat_yellow_rust.prevention: Use resistant varieties where available, control insect vectors, and keep the area free of weeds that host viruses.
wheat_yellow_rust.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.
